title.narrative: Household assets index Improvement

description.narrative: The asset index is an index constructed using a principal component analysis (PCA) that is normalized to a scale of zero to one, because each PCA is constructed for each SMA they cannot be compared to each other. The asset index assigns a relative score to proxy for the wealth level of each individual in the analysis. Different combinations of assets were used in the construction of the PCA due to insignificant variation in some assets by nature of the commodities sourced by each SMA. The 0.39 amount is the pooled indicator across the 5 SMAs selected for the Baseline and Impact Assessment.

comment.narrative: The Fund was officially launched 0n 24 January 2017.The Household assets index of 0.39 is the pooled statistics for respondents associated with the five selected SMAs where baseline surveys were conducted as SMA1 in 2017 SMA2 in 2018 . Surveys for SMA34 5 were conducted in 2022. For purposes of tracking this output on the Funds activities the Baseline date assumed is the Launch of the Fund.
The target Household assets index of 0.59 represents a 50 improvement.
